2.50.10
Matrix.Height
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Matrix.Height element specifies the height of a Matrix. This element is optional. If this element
is specified, its value MUST be a non-negative RDLSize constant.
If specified, the value of Matrix.Height after performing the above validations will always be ignored.
Regardless of whether the element is specified, the value of Matrix.Height MUST be derived from the
sum of the heights of the component parts of the matrix, which are the matrix detail rows and column
headers.
Following is the parent element of the Matrix.Height element.
Parent elements
Matrix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Matrix.Height element.
 <xsd:element name="Height" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
